Projects

My work connects functioning robotic systems with controlled evaluation and real human interaction.

OpenChessRobot

A robot that sees the board, plays chess and talks with its opponent. An open platform for human–robot interaction research.

Human-like attention?

How voice, gestures and the operator’s physical position shape mobile robot control, studied with 218 operators.

Current directions

VLA post-training

LoRA fine-tuning of GR00T N1.6 and robustness evaluation under changed language and scene appearance. Work to date is offline; robot deployment remains a next step.

In progress · Since April 2026

Datasets for an LLM-judge router

Evaluation datasets and a leaderboard for an LLM judge that routes tasks between humans and models, as a part-time MARS V fellow with the Cambridge AI Safety Hub. Mentored by the founders of Sampura Research, a non-profit started by two former Google DeepMind researchers.

In progress · Since June 2026

Scientific agent loops

Designing a controlled comparison of fixed experimental plans, adaptive iteration and structured memory, followed by a test of strategy transfer.
